_about.purpose: TTS engine endpoints. Mirrors config/ports.json / config/logging.json: edit HERE, not in code. Consumed by app/core/tts_settings.py and app/api/voice_pocket.py.

fields.pocket.base_url: Pocket TTS server base URL (tailnet-only bind on the rig).
fields.pocket.token_env: Name of the environment variable holding the per-launch Pocket Bearer token. The token value itself is NEVER stored here -- env var only, server-side only.
fields.pocket.default_voice: Voice preselected by the Voice Live page.
fields.live.stt_model: faster-whisper model name for the /api/voice/live cascade (cached in HF_HOME; 'base' is the fast default).
fields.live.llm_model: Ollama model for replies; empty string uses config.default_model.
fields.live.voice: Pocket voice used for spoken replies.
fields.live.sample_rate_in: Mic PCM rate expected from the browser (Hz).
fields.live.endpoint_silence_ms: Silence after speech that ends an utterance.
fields.live.barge_speech_ms: Continuous speech during TTS playback that triggers barge-in.
fields.live.max_utterance_s: Hard cap on buffered user speech per turn.
